shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls; cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -60
for f in lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; git diff

cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_instant\|instant navigation" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
f=$(find .next/server/app -name 'product.html' | head -1); echo $f; grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability...\|in stock' $f | sort | uniq -c; git status --short
